freeze_policy: Do not alter frozen judgments or queries after retrieval or results are observed. Changes require a new fixture version.
authorship_limits: The fixture is source-authored and purposively sampled, not drawn from observed user searches or a probability sample.
New owner paths have zero overlap with the supplied 108 exclusions; source families are not disjoint, and most owners belong to native hook, journal and persona lifecycle code.
Natural-language queries and relevance judgments were authored by one independent agent from source inspection; no independent human adjudication was performed.
Source-derived wording may resemble declarations and comments, so this fixture does not establish general semantic search quality or transfer to unrelated repositories.
Negative labels concern explicit unsupported operations or constraints in the cited inspected code. They are bounded judgments, not exhaustive repository-wide absence proofs.
No retrieval implementation, index, prior query fixture, baseline, result report, role content, agent history, model call, MCP retrieval, network operation or executable test informed the judgments.
Only query shape, source anchoring, source hashes and owner exclusion overlap were checked before freezing; no retrieval or semantic success claim follows from those checks.
